content:
Case 1: A on Monday — B can be Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday: \(3\) choices. Remaining 3 students fill 3 days: \(3!\) ways.  
\[
3 \cdot 3! = 18
\]

Case 2: A on Tuesday — B can be Monday, Wednesday, or Thursday: \(3\) choices. Remaining 3 students fill 3 days: \(3!\) ways.  
\[
3 \cdot 3! = 18
\]

Total:
\[
18+18=36
\]

\boxed{36}
